body:
Released in [`@emseepea/server` 0.23.0](https://github.com/emseepea/emseepea/releases/tag/%40emseepea%2Fserver%400.23.0). Add `list` to a protected, discoverable `defineResourceTemplate` to enumerate the caller’s resource metadata through `resources/list`. The framework authenticates the whole list, authorizes each source before backend calls, bounds combined pages, and protects cursors against another caller or permission view. Reads recheck access.

[The inventory guide](https://emseepea.github.io/emseepea/resource-inventory/) documents the callback contract, verified user subjects, ownership checks, and limits: live pages, fixed fifteen-minute expiry, and process-local cursors that require a fresh listing after restart or instance changes. No native ChatGPT Sources integration or list-change notifications are claimed.

The release implements the human-ratified ADR-0115. Exact-source qualification, Source Quality, semantic Release checks, registry integrity/signature/provenance and fresh-install checks, and Publish have passed; all planned public versions are available on `latest`, and the guide is deployed. The protocol suite covers shared-client owner isolation, unauthorized callbacks, cursor tampering and expiry, record revocation, concurrent changes, multiple sources, bounds, and legacy clients, including fresh packed installs.
